packages.name: Python

changelog.2.0.0: No more IPython: run files or use a plain Python prompt straight away. Also: python <file>, python -c.

packages.name: System Monitor
packages.description: A live dashboard of PythonOS itself: its CPU, memory, tasks and storage.

changelog.1.0.1: Now says what it can do (permissions: shown before you install, enforced while it runs), is listed in the new categories, and handles Ctrl+C and command-line arguments cleanly.
changelog.1.1.0: New: per-core CPU, history sparklines and graphs ('sysmon graph'), temperature and battery, and alerts when a limit is crossed ('sysmon alerts').
changelog.1.2.0: Looks only at PythonOS (its processes and tasks, its memory against the memory it owns), not the rest of the computer, so other programs no longer show up. Works on the live ISO and small screens: every reading is optional, the display fits the terminal, and a problem is explained instead of a crash. Network and per-core CPU are gone (they cannot be told apart from the rest of the computer).

changelog.1.0.0: First release: search, play a link or a playlist, queue, with mpv, VLC or ffplay.
changelog.1.1.0: The yt-dlp library is now installed by the marketplace into the app's own folder (marketplace API 2), so nothing is asked the first time you run it.
changelog.1.2.0: Plays the sound itself (av and miniaudio libraries, installed by the marketplace); it no longer uses or needs mpv, VLC or ffplay.
changelog.1.2.1: Declares where it works: Windows and Linux (the locked-down ISO cannot run apps with libraries; Android has no sound output for apps).
